header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: wind will reach and cause him also to die. After that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “After this only the wicked, without Iman, will remain in the world; the speed and restlessness of birds will be found in those wicked people; just as birds flutter and fly swiftly, they will act swiftly in fulfilling their desires. And (like beasts they will commit injustice and atrocities against others.) They will not regard good as good, nor evil as evil. Shaytan will appear before them in some form and ask, “Will you not obey me?” They will say, “What do you command us?” (We are ready to act according to your command.) He will command them to worship idols (and they will act according to his command). In those days they will be in great wealth and abundance. Their life will be (outwardly) prosperous and full of comfort and luxury. Then the Sur will be blown. Whoever hears that sound (will lose consciousness from its terror and shock. And because of it, their heads will not stay upright on their bodies); rather, their necks will tilt this way and that. The first to hear the sound of the Sur will be a man who is repairing with mud the trough in which water is put for camels. He will be the first to be struck by the sound of the Sur. He will fall down senseless and lifeless, and will die. Likewise the other people will also fall lifeless. Then Allah will send down a (light) rain like dewdrops. Because of it, life will come into the bodies of people. Then, when the Sur is blown a second time, all of them together will stand up. They will be looking (here and there). It will be said to them, “O people, go to your Lord!’ and also, “Stop them (on the plain of reckoning)”
